contact-module.$description: Tokens for ContactModule, the contact box in the property detail page's sidebar (audit capture: 340px, phone, Message, Contact, broker, logo, Share and Favorite). Decision 30.

border-color.$description: OBSERVED: 1px #e5e5e5. Decorative: the shadow also marks the box.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 12-23px between phone, Message, heading and broker; became 16px.

icon-size.$description: OBSERVED: a 23px phone icon before the number; became 24px.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 'Contact', h3 at 22px; became the heading-3 style (20px).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 400; semibold like the other headings.

divider.$description: OBSERVED: a 1px #e5e5e5 line above Share and Favorite, and one between them. Decorative.

action-height.$description: OBSERVED: 61px Share and Favorite buttons; became 56px (4px grid), each half the width.
